name: Don't Pick Up Stray Aliens!
source:
Another day has gone by. Too much paperwork, too little energy... and on the way home you see a tall blond guy bowing to a vending machine like it just committed an unforgivable damage to it.

He claims he's an alien who crashed here months ago. Tried many forms to survive: streetlight, cat, mailbox... But he says the human body is the easiest to handle.

With a notebook in hand, his eyes gleaming like a puppy's, he asks you: "please teach me how to be human".

How can you not bring him home?

[From [url=https://yorubox.itch.io/dont-pick-up-stray-aliens]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
又一天过去了。太多的文书工作，太少的精力……在回家的路上，你看到一个高个子金发男人向一台自动售货机鞠躬，就像它刚刚对它造成了不可原谅的损坏一样。

他声称自己是几个月前坠毁在这里的外星人。尝试了多种生存形式：路灯、猫、邮箱……但他说人体是最容易处理的。

他手里拿着笔记本，眼睛像小狗一样闪闪发光，他问你：“请教我如何做人”。

怎么能不带他回家呢？

[来自[url=https://yorubox.itch.io/dont-pick-up-stray-aliens]itch.io[/url]]
